original_primary_documents.name: Connection level pre-requisite for API connection of NSEINVEST 1_Draft1.pdf

source_conflicts.action: Keep43 document schema and44 explicit captured-source variant separate. Obtain complete source/header-bound PROD evidence before selecting current MFData parser.
source_conflicts.fact: Web structure documents43 positions; existing TLAM strict parser expects44 observed UAT header columns, adding OPEN/CLOSE ENDED SCHEME. Several field names also differ.

source_conflicts.action: Retain both explicit versions and their provenance; absence of STEPUP_FLAG is not evidence that Step Up is supported.
source_conflicts.fact: Document has22 fields plus five blank fillers. Existing code accepts that27 layout or STEPUP_FLAG inserted at23 plus five fillers, total28.

source_conflicts.action: Record width discrepancy and exact normalization. Unknown token is not an eligible mode.
source_conflicts.fact: Document declares CHAR1; retained-local source documentation records DP as well as D/P. Existing code resolves DP to D+P.

source_conflicts.action: Do not invent STEPUP or SIP_STEP_UP request type. Production operation/layout/field completeness remains unverified.
source_conflicts.fact: API1.9.8 p163 lists only six three-character types. Existing TLAM code accepts SIP_STEP_UP as a response filename under SIP, not a new requested file_type.

source_conflicts.action: Reconcile ownership and build a reviewed reference-only PROD connector rather than reuse an assumed all-family production capability.
source_conflicts.fact: Current TLAM downloadMasterOnce permits SCH/SIP/SET, but non-SCH requires UAT. STP/SWP/NAV are not supported in that transport.

source_conflicts.action: Do not infer/reorder columns from a header, replace AMFI NAV or infer transaction execution price.
source_conflicts.fact: API p163 explicitly says NAV has no header; Web p83 lists eight positions.

source_conflicts.action: Do not use SET absence as proof of non-business days, complete market holidays or transaction eligibility.
source_conflicts.fact: Seven fields represent settlement type/number and trade/pay-in/pay-out dates.

source_conflicts.action: Record the discrepancy; verify exact environment at later authorized reference-read time. It is not a reason to block this source inventory or introduce IAM/network changes.
source_conflicts.fact: API1.9.8 p5 requires IP mapping; earlier user reports existing user has no whitelist requirement. No current connection was tested.
